title: Small-space vermicomposting
summary: Use a ventilated worm bin for selected food scraps where outdoor compost is impractical.
steps: Use a lidded ventilated bin with moist bedding and composting worms suitable for the system.
Add small amounts of chopped fruit and vegetable scraps, coffee grounds and plain plant material.
Bury new food under bedding and wait until most is consumed before adding more.
Correct odour or flies by removing unsuitable food, reducing feed and adding dry bedding.
Harvest finished castings separately and introduce them gradually to potting mix or soil.
